clock_fraction_15: Estonian counting-toward-the-hour clock: "veerand <H>" == a quarter of the
way toward hour H, i.e. (H-1):15 -- "veerand uheksa" == 08:15.  Citation:
Erelt, Mati (ed.) "Estonian Language", Linguistica Uralica Suppl. Series 1,
Estonian Academy Publishers 2003, time-expression sec.; EKI Eesti Keele
clock_fraction_30: Estonian counting-toward-the-hour clock: "pool <H>" == half of the way
toward hour H, i.e. (H-1):30 -- "pool uheksa" == 08:30 (half before nine).
Citation: Erelt, Mati (ed.) "Estonian Language", Estonian Academy
clock_fraction_45: quarters of the way toward hour H, i.e. (H-1):45 -- "kolmveerand uheksa"
Academy Publishers 2003, time-expression sec.; EKI "Sonaveeb" entry
